title: Houthis Threaten to Expand Red Sea Attacks, and Claim Strike on Saudi Tanker
summary: Saudi Arabia has not commented on the claim by the Houthis, who are backed by Iran and have vowed to close “all access routes” to Saudi oil shipments.
